reviews.text: Not only is this game great and fun to play the customer service is excellent to say the least. Unlike other games I have played and given up on due to the lack of CS and the generic less interactive response given to players this is top notch. Why is that? Well, when I first addressed my issue within 24hrs I got an actual concerned response. After a few back and forth messages my issue and concern was resolved. Very impressed and satisfied. reviews.title: Was great, now entirely pay to play
reviews.text:
Most of the (daily) tasks in the game are tedious and offer little reward. Even spending upwards of $100/week won’t guarantee you can complete the weekly challenges. This was something that could previously be completed at little/no cost. 

As the game population dwindles, the devs alienate their base instead of offering them incentives to stay. Characters you’ve spent literally hundreds of dollars upgrades are nerfed with no ability to redistribute those funds/jade elsewhere. My advice: skip all games from this developer. I would assume similar disappointing end game dynamics with anything they produce.

reviews.title: Lost their way
reviews.text: The game is great, the devs and admin are horrible. They continually “fix” weekly events to ensure only those willing to spend $$$ or are extreme top level players can complete. They then hide behind offering more of the coveted rewards but at an unattainable level. Once you reach about lvl 90 (max is 110 currently) you stall out if you aren’t spending big money. It takes maybe two months to get to 90 then can take a year to get to 100. These are the players most affected by the mismanagement of the game too weak to gain ground on the top level players and with the changes constantly being made these are the ones that now get further behind even though they state the changes are to “help” these players. If you plan on downloading this game be aware the first month or two you will be addicted you move up fast enemies are at an equal strength as the heroes. But beware once you hit mid 80’s in character level you will start to see the issues, between needing the heroes needed in the last world you are now going to need to work on different heroes to pass the next one but spent all your time leveling up the ones needed earlier and when you finally get them there they will need those and you will be again stuck. I’ve been playing since the early stages and I must say the changes are making the game less and less fun and more and more deflating.

reviews.title: Greedy devs
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game for nearly 2 years now. I’m level 94, VIP 3, so I’ve seen a bunch- and here’s my honest review. The game used to be WAY better. The majority of the updates are pay-to-play driven, And i don’t know if they notice, but they are losing players after every major change- They are slowly taking away everything that you need to upgrade your team/army and making it nearly impossible to get any better without paying real money. The game is still fun, but it seems I’m just on everyday to run through the motions because i know it will be WEEKS before i can get any further. Devs need to realize that the more difficult they make allowing players to get better, the more difficult it will be to hold onto players. If you take away the ability to get better, your going to lose players, and that’s exactly what they’ve done. And then the server merge- LOL. You mean your losing players to the point that one server barely has any active players so you need to merge them together so you bring all the players onto less and less servers. At some point there’s only going to be one server. One last note for the devs- I used to be able to complete every event every month- now i am lucky if i can complete some of them every 3 months. But don’t worry- if you spend some real money you can have an advantage.

reviews.title: Game is dead

Continuous nerfs on every event and aspect of the game making it impossible to advance without spending enormous amounts of cash. Numerous server merges have been necessary just to keep the major spenders around. Almost all casual players have quit and more then half the remaining players have boycotted spending any more. The Dev’s are just milking what they can from the whales now.
